title: TextureMatchRequest
description: The 'request' part of a 'texture-match' job (runner protocol 1.2; parts 'photo', 'texture' and optionally 'mask', one image each): the arguments of IPhotoTextureSession.Match. One facet per job. The photo is decoded without its EXIF orientation.

seed.description: Predicted photo px to texture px homography, row-major 3x3; absent runs the coarse search.

attempt.description: PhotoTextureAttempt: which deterministic variant to run; absent is {0, null, 1}.
